---
name: Security vulnerability
about: Do not use this template for actual vulnerability reports
---

**Stop — do not file vulnerability details here.**

Public GitHub issues are visible to everyone, including anyone who might exploit an
unpatched vulnerability. Security reports must go through a private channel instead.

Please report the vulnerability by emailing **wael@helmies.fi**, per
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md). Do not post reproduction steps, affected
endpoints, payloads, or any other exploit details in a public issue, comment, or PR.

If you've opened this template by mistake and already included details, email
wael@helmies.fi so we can help get the issue removed, then delete the details from
the issue body.
